title: Data Collection and Indexing Standards
purpose: Standardize how benchmark data, analysis results, and operational metrics are collected, stored, and indexed across the repository. Establishes the three-tier index system (SUMMARY.json, INDEX_COMPACT.json, full index.json) and defines required fields, naming conventions, and cross-reference requirements. Based on empirical evidence that the three-tier system enables 90.2% token savings (11.7x speedup) when agents query indexes, transforming 16 index reads per context window into 190.
scope: All data files produced by benchmarks, analyses, team operations, and tool outputs. Applies to storage/data/, storage/scripts/, storage/coordination/, knowledge-base/, and market-research/ directories.

three_tier_impact.speedup: 77.1x (SUMMARY vs full index), 49.5x (query_kb vs full index)
three_tier_impact.agent_operations_per_context: ~190 with tiered indexes vs ~16 with raw file reads

index_lookup_performance.hash_speedup: 12.9x for scripts, 6.5x for tools, 8.4x for sources

data_gathering_improvement.lesson: Structured data collection with consistent indexing enables compounding improvement across iterations

tier_1_summary.purpose: Ultra-compact directory overview for agent orientation. Answers: what is in this directory, how many entries, what date range?
tier_1_summary.when_agents_use_it: First read when entering any directory. Determines if the directory is relevant before deeper reads.

example.purpose: Contains 3 benchmark analysis files and 1 convergence report

tier_2_compact_index.purpose: One-line-per-entry index for scanning. Answers: what specific entries exist and what type/category are they?
tier_2_compact_index.when_agents_use_it: When agent needs to find a specific entry by ID, title, or category. Faster than reading full index.

tier_3_full_index.purpose: Complete metadata for all entries. Includes descriptions, cross-references, file paths, and all searchable fields.
tier_3_full_index.when_agents_use_it: When agent needs full details about entries, cross-references, or needs to update/add entries.
tier_3_full_index.note: Prefer query_kb or smart_read over reading the full index directly. query_kb returns 123 tokens vs 6093 for the full file.

procedures.title: Determine Data Category and Storage Location
procedures.action: Before storing any data file, classify it and identify the correct storage location.

storage_locations.benchmark_results: storage/scripts/ (tool and coordination benchmarks) or storage/scripts/data-gathering/benchmarks/ (data gathering)

procedures.title: Apply Naming Conventions
procedures.action: Name the file according to the conventions for its category.

procedures.title: Include Required Metadata Fields
procedures.action: Every data file must include metadata fields appropriate to its type.
procedures.output: Data file with all required metadata fields populated

procedures.title: Update All Three Index Tiers
procedures.action: After creating or modifying a data file, update all three tiers of the index system in the file's directory.
update_order: 1. Update index.json (full index) with complete entry metadata
2. Update INDEX_COMPACT.json with one-line entry summary
3. Update SUMMARY.json with updated entry_count, categories, last_updated, and id_range
procedures.automation: Use auto_index tool (storage/scripts/auto_index.py) when available. Falls back to manual updates.
procedures.output: All three index tiers consistent and up-to-date

procedures.title: Add Cross-References
procedures.action: Link the new data to related entries using cross-reference fields.

cross_reference_types.builds_on: This entry extends or refines the referenced entry. E.g., SOP-034 builds_on SOP-032.
cross_reference_types.references: This entry cites data from the referenced source. Include section and data_points count.
cross_reference_types.superseded_by: This entry has been replaced by a newer version. Mark old entry status as 'superseded'.
cross_reference_types.related_entries: Entries covering similar topics or sharing data sources.

procedures.cross_reference_performance: Indexed cross-reference lookup is 6.6x faster than linear scan (0.29us vs 1.92us). Always use indexed lookups.
procedures.output: Cross-references added to new entry and referenced entries updated if needed

procedures.title: Validate Index Consistency
procedures.action: After updates, validate that indexes are consistent with actual files on disk.
validation_checks: Every file in the directory has a corresponding index entry
Every index entry points to an existing file
SUMMARY.json entry_count matches actual file count
INDEX_COMPACT.json entries match index.json entries (subset of fields)
All cross-references point to valid entries
procedures.tools: Use kb_validator (storage/scripts/kb_validator.py) and cross_ref_checker (storage/scripts/cross_ref_checker.py) for automated validation.

benchmark_data.minimum_measurements: 50 per metric (consistent with empirical benchmarks using 50-200 measurements per condition)
benchmark_data.comparison_requirement: All benchmark results must include comparison to established baseline when one exists

analysis_data.source_attribution: Every finding must cite specific data sources with section references
analysis_data.confidence_levels: HIGH (multiple independent sources agree), MEDIUM (single source or limited observations), LOW (extrapolation or single data point)
analysis_data.actionable_format: Analysis must include actionable_recommendations section with immediate/short_term/long_term categories

team_output_data.artifact_tracking: Every team output must be catalogued with artifact count and type for efficiency measurement
team_output_data.session_logging: Required fields: team_id, agent_count, duration, artifacts_produced, cooperation_pattern, efficiency_score

anti_patterns.name: Index-Less Data Dumping
anti_patterns.description: Creating data files without updating any index tier.
anti_patterns.why_wrong: Unindexed data is invisible to agents using smart_read/query_kb. Other teams cannot discover or build on the data. Effectively lost work.
anti_patterns.fix: Always update all three index tiers (SUMMARY, INDEX_COMPACT, full index) when adding data.

anti_patterns.name: Full Index Only
anti_patterns.description: Maintaining only index.json without SUMMARY.json or INDEX_COMPACT.json.
anti_patterns.why_wrong: Forces agents to read the full 6093-token index for simple orientation queries. Wastes 98.7% of tokens that SUMMARY.json would save.
anti_patterns.fix: Maintain all three tiers. SUMMARY for orientation (79 tokens), INDEX_COMPACT for scanning (50 tokens/entry), index.json for full details.

anti_patterns.name: Inconsistent Cross-References
anti_patterns.description: Adding builds_on or references that point to non-existent entries.
anti_patterns.why_wrong: Broken cross-references mislead agents and fail validation. Cross-ref checker catches these but only if run.
anti_patterns.fix: Validate cross-references after every update using cross_ref_checker.py.

anti_patterns.name: Raw File I/O for Index Reads
anti_patterns.description: Reading full index.json files directly instead of using query_kb or smart_read.
anti_patterns.why_wrong: Full file reads consume 6093 tokens. query_kb returns 123 tokens for the same result (49.5x savings). Raw reads waste 90% of context budget.
anti_patterns.fix: Always use query_kb for index queries and smart_read for entry reads. Reserve full file reads for index updates only.

references.data_points: Hash vs linear lookup benchmarks, category and cross-ref benchmarks
Iteration comparison showing 371% data point increase
Token efficiency insight (11.7x speedup, 190 vs 16 operations per context)

compliance_indicators: All data files have corresponding entries in all three index tiers
SUMMARY.json exists and is accurate for every indexed directory
All cross-references resolve to valid entries
Benchmark results include required percentiles (p50, p95, p99)
Analysis results include source attribution and confidence levels
metrics.measurement_method: Run kb_validator and cross_ref_checker after every data update. Track token consumption for index reads. Flag any directory missing SUMMARY.json or INDEX_COMPACT.json.
